findings.title: The comment covers non-draftable pawns only; a draftable pawn with Full on an ability that can't approach keeps Full
findings.detail: Line 253 turns Full into Stationary only when pawns[i].drafter == null. A draftable pawn whose ability has no approachDistance (CanApproach false), still showing an earlier Full, keeps Full when Full is picked again. The new comment only claims the non-draftable case, so it is correct; this case is left unsaid, which is fine. The player-visible effect of the stored change is cosmetic: the badge goes from Full to Stationary and the menu stops listing Full.
